nom: La Roche-Posay Travel Size Toleriane Purifying Foaming Face Wash for Oily Skin

avis.texte: It's a nice way to try before buying a big one. I'll probably try the oily skin one next time.

avis.titre: I would not buy this again!
avis.texte: The first 3 days I loved how clean my face felt after use. It was all good until it wasn't. I have sensitive skin and oily tzones this product was too strong for me. My skin was dried and broke out in hives. A recommendation that was over hyped.

avis.titre: Love this cleanser! Just use it correctly :)
avis.texte: This is a GREAT cleanser for combination/oily skin (even mature skin). Unless I have a packed on face of makeup, I don't even do a pre cleanse. The key to this performing well is to use a small amount and mix with a lot of water to suds it up, using your fingers. Then use a cloth to complete the cleansing. Does a great job without drying me out.

avis.titre: Works Good but Brand Tests on Animals
avis.texte: The face wash has worked well for me if it was just about the quality; id give it a 4 out of 5, but only after buying it did I realize the brand tests on animals. So, it took serious points off for me.

avis.titre: Great for sensitive and oily skin!
avis.texte: I love using this product after evening showers. I have sensitive skin and tend to get very oily and shiny throughout the day, especially during a workday when sitting under lighting for 8 hours. Highly recommend if you have these issues and suggest following with light moisturizer (i use cerave pm)! Wet hands, and rub together until foaming then GENTLY massage over face for about 30 seconds and rinse with warm water! Follow up with cold rinse before applying moisturizer.

I bought this because I had some oily sections in my chin. One had a deep pimple/cyst. It did help dry that out but after a week I noticed that my skin was red and raw in the other parts. Turns out I had a reaction to it :( Smell was fine, didn't feel goopy, did help make skin feel clean.
My face is more prone to sun damage after using more sensitive and red
I like the way the product is despensed. I've started buying travel sizes so that I don't have to label things
I bought this to clean my face daily but it made my face breakout in alot of pimples. Ive never had pimples before so this was very upsetting. My face is super dry and itchy now.

I would definitely buy this again i got the travel size cause i didnt know if it would break me ou tor not but it doesn't and my face is very sensitive and oily i love this and would recommend and depending on how much you use it could go a long ways!
